HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   D. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   B. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   C. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

5. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   B. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.

7. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.

8. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.

9. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.

10. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   C. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain National Security and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Human Developments in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Colonial Administration in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
